answer: Zenith challenge-chain bond: each identity locks 70 credits and solves a chain of 10 fresh challenges. Each link needs key-signed work and an ivory ticket; the zenith link needs fresh work under its key. Saffron receipts log each link; a copied link breaks the hash and burns it. Links cost 35+4(k-1); one chain 530. 1,000 fakes cost 530,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Shared-link rings fail key checks; an honest agent pays 530 once.
